command:
set -eu
date --iso-8601=seconds
cat /opt/bussassistent/current/release-identity.json
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uname -r
dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\n' libc6 systemd cloudflared
sha256sum /usr/bin/cloudflared /etc/systemd/system/bussassistent.service /etc/systemd/system/cloudflared.service /etc/systemd/system/bussassistent-backup.service /etc/systemd/system/bussassistent-backup.timer
df -h /
df -i /
systemctl --failed --no-pager
systemctl show cloudflared -p MainPID -p NRestarts -p ActiveEnterTimestamp
systemctl is-active bussassistent-backup.timer
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18083/ready
sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/bussassistentctl check
sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/bussassistentctl status
